runtime: local workerd / R2 / SQLite Durable Objects

checked_integrations.includes: Signed intent, draft, server commit, real Docker check and DO admission; short local trial, not a 24-hour capacity claim.

branch_updates.includes: Object PUT, durable conditional head update and receipt read; excludes merge computation and CI.

measurement_notes: All storage and execution were local on one Mac; no paid Cloudflare or model calls.
History and worktree sizes count uncompressed Git bytes; most blobs are compressible. Dense bytes and physical storage are separate.
Automatic approval and a synthetic syntax/checksum Docker contract; this is not representative production CI or a 24-hour capacity proof.
The throughput run used a 1024-entry object cache and uncached object-size HEAD reads. Later changes cache those sizes and raise the entry cap to 8192, preserving the 32 MiB byte cap.
